summary: Reproduced the sanitize-to-uniform failure on the assigned gfx950 GPU and added an opt-in SGLANG_ABORT_ON_NAN_LOGITS plain-sampling containment path. Fully-NaN rows are detected before sanitization, carried on the existing result D2H path, and aborted with HTTP 503 before a sampled token is committed. The request KV is released without radix-cache insertion; partial-row NaNs and the default-disabled behavior are unchanged.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with a 163840-wide logits tensor, sanitization changed the full-NaN row to one constant and softmax had max absolute error 0.0 from the uniform reference; the new mask was [true, false] and the partial-row control retained argmax token 42. Raw output is in reports/j-865863970a57/raw/gpu-nan-reproduction.txt.

24 tests and 4 subtests passed, covering full-versus-partial detection, env-off behavior, selective 503 abort and cache-insert suppression, ignored finished/retracted/middle-chunk rows, mask boundaries, and neighboring prefill/decode/Mamba cleanup behavior.

tests.command: /opt/venv/bin/pre-commit run --files <all changed source, documentation, and test files>
tests.what_was_measured: Repository formatting, lint, spelling, AST, secret, registry, and related pre-commit checks all passed.
All changed Python modules and the regression test compiled successfully.
No whitespace errors in the delivered patch.

gpu_evidence: reports/j-865863970a57/raw/gpu-info.txt records the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, and gpu-nan-reproduction.txt records torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 execution with device_count=1.
remaining_limitations: The reported Kimi-K3 weights, Blackwell SM10x hardware, TP=8 topology, and production transient NaN source were unavailable; this does not claim reproduction of that model/kernel root cause.
The deterministic GPU fixture validates the reported logits/sampling failure mechanism and mask computation, not Kimi-K3 semantic accuracy or a full model request.

The new abort path is intentionally limited to plain sampling, matching the report where speculative decoding was disabled. Speculative verification needs algorithm-specific row-to-request mapping and remains unsupported by this flag.
No full HTTP server was launched because no qualified model weights were needed to establish the sampler/result-processing defect; existing FINISH_ABORT response machinery supplies the 503.
